scope: PR #133 blocker fix only: ACP v1 JSON-RPC envelope exclusivity, strict jsonrpc/UTF-8 decoding, and initialize-result schema checks. No real agent connection, session/prompt, authentication execution, MCP delegation, or model selection was added.
implemented: Every stdout record must carry jsonrpc exactly equal to the string "2.0" (missing, numeric, or other strings are protocol failures).

Request (method + id), notification (method only), and response (id + exactly one of result/error) are classified exclusively; method+result/error, result+error, invalid id type, and unknown response id fail the protocol.
initialize result checks pinned v1 AgentCapabilities booleans, nested prompt/mcp/session/auth fields, agentInfo name/version/title, and each AuthMethod id/name/description plus terminal args/env.
Allowed extension fields (including _meta and unrecognized capability keys) are not rejected merely for being unknown.
stdout records are decoded with a fatal UTF-8 TextDecoder so invalid bytes cannot become U+FFFD and pass JSON.parse.
A malformed record during initialize emits no ready state; start() rejects only after pending requests, timers, and signal handlers are released and the owned child has been stopped and awaited.
Normal v1 initialize then stop and the -32601 agent-to-client request rejection are unchanged.
